title: Private room in Rosebery · desk & garden

paragraphs.text: A private room in a house in Rosebery, sleeping up to 2 guests.
The room has one queen bed and a lock on the bedroom door.
The bathroom is shared, and the listing says so plainly.
There is a dedicated desk and air conditioning — fine for a workday, quiet at night.
The room photos are real; ask and we will send more angles.
You can use the kitchen, washing machine, TV and piano, plus Wi-Fi and the dedicated workspace.
Free parking on the premises; the back garden has an outdoor dining area and a BBQ.
House rules: up to 2 overnight guests; pets are allowed.
The room has air conditioning. If winter warmth matters to you, please ask before booking.
Check-in and check-out times, Wi-Fi and door access are sent by the host after booking.
There is a hair dryer in the bathroom; the room has a smoke alarm, a carbon monoxide alarm, a fire extinguisher and a first aid kit.
